## Drafter doubts: verdicts

- ese-ü buγsažu aγsad (words 204-206, unit 32): negation was unrendered and the rendering "held back" reversed it. Fixed (high): now "unrestrained", consistent with the Ming 不曾 and with the glossary's "ese before a converb = not yet". The second ese-ü (word 297, unit 48, "Now … rejoicing") stays unrendered because the negative does not fit; note now says why and offers the two readings (rhetorical question; idiom with edöġe). Not resolved by me; left flagged.
- qor "loss" (53) vs qor "quiver" (434): kept as two words. The glossary has qor = quiver [箭筒]; the Ming 折損 for word 53 and 帶弓箭的 for qortu (434) both support the split. The glosser must broaden under __broaden__, not overwrite. Note on unit 8 now points to qortu.
- asan (241): Ming 擔 "carry/load" vs the glossary's name Asan. Kept as a common word, flagged uncertain in morph and note; the i "with the mountain at his back" is an interpretation and the note says so. Glosser: broaden, do not overwrite the name entry.
- Ödchigin portrait (536-543): l "at-evening" vs i "late" aligned; "and yet" softened to "and even so"; note's inference "one may not catch him sleeping" removed (it contradicted untaγči). The sense of the pair (sleeps early, rises late, never left behind) is still doubtful and the note says so.
- Names: Sübeġetei → Sübegetei (Sübegei is the other man, 178-181); Uru'ud → Uruqud (house, 125-130, 170-171); Aṅγuγ̇a → Angqu'a (ṅγ → ngq as in Mongqud, Dongqaid). Jamuqa, Jebe, Qubilai, Jelme, Jüchi-Qasar, Mother Högelün, Ödchigin Noyan, Chakirma'ud, Qachir agree with the house.
- Segmentation 382-386: kept (new sentence after keġebe., Shiratori's stop). 456-461: kept (stop at qarbuju. 459; qorin haran-i is the object of the first shot, Kereldügsen begins the second). Two cuts that were wrong and are fixed: naγur (67) moved to unit 12; büleġei (378) joined to its clause in unit 59.

## Findings refused, with reason

- titleEn "The Battle at Naqu Cliff": the section ends before the fighting; I left it, since the part's name is the owner's/drafter's choice and the about-field says "the eve of the battle". Caller may rename.
- ele (Ming 但) unrendered in i at units 37, 50, 62, 81: force unsettled in the glossary (and the notes say so); an English particle would assert a reading. Left.
- aisqun / aisqu (-qun, -qu) beside aisunqun (-nqun): analyses differ for spelling variants of one word. Glossary has only aisunqun; unprovable either way, left, but the glosser should not merge them without a note.
- qadququj-a "-j-a dative-locative after a linking j" (words 350, 356): doubtful, but hedged in the morph and note ("I think"); no better analysis available from the Ming alone.
- i "wretches" kept nowhere; "lowly ones" used instead (see changes). i unit 76/77 "it flies" for qarbuju: acceptable subject shift (the arrow), left.
- i unit 86 "who is called the one with a liver": awkward but honest (heligetü, Ming 肝有的); the note explains and refuses to claim "courageous". Left.
- Sense of unit 8 (qor bolumn-že) and the -umn ending: unresolved, honestly flagged in the note; only the English phrasing was changed.
- Unit 5 i "saw him" (Tayang) vs a collective: plausible and flagged in note; left.
- Tense choice "there is not so much as a lamb's hoof left" for büleġei (unit 59): a judgment; stated in the note.

# Review, pass 2 — secret-history-195-195 (§195)

Checked: units.json after pass 1 (t equals the 559 packet words, words per unit, quote balance of i by straight quotes: balanced, l/t quote counts agree, labels against forms across all morph suffixes, l against i, notes against the edited l/i); every one of the 142 gloss.json entries against the text, the packet Ming gloss (bracket equals the packet gloss for every key; four keys have a second Ming gloss on another occurrence, šiγuči, šilemelčen, doromži-ača, asaγurun) and the entry format; the two __broaden__ entries (both contain the old entry whole); known-forms.json against the units for readings the old entries do not cover. No modern translation was opened. Severity as in pass 1.

Counts: high 0, medium 7, low 17 (total 24; a table row is one finding, the batch of seven broadened entries counting once).

## Findings refused, with reason

- huruγu "downstream" (u3): the published entry already reads "downstream, following the course, along"; kept.
- tedüi "Then" (u16, Ming 卽便 'at once'): the published entry has "so, then, thereupon" with that Ming; note says 'at once'. Kept.
- u14 "reserve horses": the note calls it an interpretation of 'following'; kept.
- "sworn brother" for anda: the published parts use it. Kept.
- u48 ese-ü unrendered: pass 1 flagged it; rendered as the affirmative sense of a rhetorical question, which agrees with u32. Left; the doubt stays in the note.
- u86 "one with a liver": left as in pass 1; the note says the Ming does not decide.
- u76 note "about six feet" for a fathom: external measure, but it explains and is not a translation. Left.
- γunažin "from γurban?": hedged as uncertain; left.
- jorčil, tatam, aisu-lu, qadququj-a, idešitü, amsaγari: analyses are hedged "uncertain" in entry and note; no better reading from the Ming alone.
- Second Ming glosses on šiγuči (鑿子), šilemelčen (垂涎), asaγurun (問): bare forms of the same Ming word; not worth a broaden.
